claims: Runs displays all 186 persisted DeepEval example results with failures first
A failed example drills into input, output, reference, evaluator feedback, tokens, cost, latency, and its canonical OTLP trace
The linked logical execution opens only its relevant span waterfall and sidecars
Evals exposes 27 evaluator definitions and complete setup
isolation: Real local Chorus server over a local-source golden DeepEval corpus; no production DynamoDB reads, no SMS delivery, and no customer identity or secrets in the recording.
limitations: Production-trace promotion into a dataset is not exercised; this PR completes the DeepEval dataset and experiment path first.
